title: Make Soil Useful
description: Decompose dirt and run Soil separation in a Chemical Reactor. Keep room for carbon, silica and water. A supported steel ingot consumes 1,000 iron and 10 carbon units in the Synthesizer.

Silica can become glass; stored water leaves through the Synthesizer fluid tank. A full byproduct pauses the entire batch without consuming part of its input. The Chemical Reactor now handles reactions, while separation has its own machine.
